integrity.mathematical_evidence: Exact 10-state transfer determinant identity over Z[t,z], checked by bounded-degree integer interpolation, numerator initial-coefficient calculation and brute-force boundary tests.

scientific_limitations: Applies to labelled vertex subsets of open width-two ladder graphs for n>=1 only.
The scalar count, fifth-order scalar recurrence and scalar generating function are already publicly recorded as OEIS A231376 and are not claimed as new.
Historical priority of the fully size-resolved generating function is provisional; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: The full \(P_3\)-convex-set cardinality polynomial of an open ladder
